crossRefs.note: What good is it, my brothers, if a man says he has faith, but has no works? Can faith save him?
You see that faith worked with his works, and by works faith was perfected.
But he who doubts is condemned if he eats, because it isn’t of faith; and whatever is not of faith is sin.
If I have the gift of prophecy, and know all mysteries and all knowledge; and if I have all faith, so as to remove…
For in Christ Jesus neither circumcision amounts to anything, nor uncircumcision, but faith working through love.
Without faith it is impossible to be well pleasing to him, for he who comes to God must believe that he exists, and…
By faith, Rahab the prostitute didn’t perish with those who were disobedient, having received the spies in peace.
You see that faith worked with his works, and by works faith was perfected.
Who is wise and understanding among you? Let him show by his good conduct that his deeds are done in gentleness of…

There is therefore now no condemnation to those who are in Christ Jesus, who don’t walk according to the flesh, but…
Therefore if anyone is in Christ, he is a new creation. The old things have passed away. Behold, all things have become…
Having therefore these promises, beloved, let’s cleanse ourselves from all defilement of flesh and spirit, perfecting…
remembering without ceasing your work of faith and labor of love and perseverance of hope in our Lord Jesus Christ…
but the goal of this command is love, out of a pure heart and a good conscience and sincere faith,
In all things be showing yourself an example of good works. In your teaching, be showing integrity, seriousness…
For the grace of God has appeared, bringing salvation to all men,

translations.web: Yes, a man will say, “You have faith, and I have works.” Show me your faith without works, and I will show you my faith by my works.
translations.bsb: But someone will say, “You have faith and I have deeds.” Show me your faith without deeds, and I will show you my faith by my deeds.
translations.kjv: Yea, a man may say, Thou hast faith, and I have works: shew me thy faith without thy works, and I will shew thee my faith by my works.
translations.asv: Yea, a man will say, Thou hast faith, and I have works: show me thy faith apart from thy works, and I by my works will show thee my faith.
